generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table and never colliding with compact rows; never NULL; never subject to GROUP_PLANS.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent key from the final (post-dedup) parent column; include at least one child row per parent and at least one parent row without children; nullable FKs also get NULL rows.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Positive integers sampled around the observed range with boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.int_year: Integer years sampled around the observed range with boundary values at each listed literal and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample from the explicit value pool; include near-variants (case/whitespace) of listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Short distinct strings; allow near-duplicate variants to create DISTINCT duplicates and GROUP sizes of 1, 2 and >= 3.
generic_sampling_rules.text_generic: Short distinct strings; allow near-duplicate variants to create DISTINCT duplicates and GROUP sizes of 1, 2 and >= 3.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, exactly one NULL row per instance (compact null rate 0.0); planted NULLs are never overwritten.
